verdict.rationale: Washington DOR runs public web guidance pages and the My DOR online portal, so a question about opting out of usage tracking or analytics is a fair one for this kind of service. The evidence pack is entirely about licensing, tax filing workflows and machine-readability probes. Nothing documents telemetry, cookies, analytics, or any opt-out control, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
